description: This file contains unit tests for the CohortMembership class within the org.openmrs package, including methods that verify the behavior of membership activity, comparison, equality, and sorting logic.

classes.name: CohortMembershipTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing behaviors and methods of the CohortMembership class

methods.name: isMembershipActive_shouldReturnTrueIfAsOfDateIsAfterStartDate
methods.description: Tests that the membership is active when the as-of date is after the start date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnFalseIfStartDateIsAfterAsOfDate
methods.description: Verifies that a membership is inactive if the start date is after the date being tested.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeInactiveAsOfDateForVoidedMembership
methods.description: Tests that a voided membership is inactive regardless of the date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeInclusiveOfStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Checks that a membership is active on its start and end boundary dates.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldCompareMembershipsForEquality
methods.description: Ensures that compareTo returns zero for identical memberships.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldCompareBasedOnPatientId
methods.description: Verifies comparison based on patient IDs.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldSortByStartDate
methods.description: Checks sorting order based on start dates.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldFailIfStartOrEndDateDoNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures comparison fails if start/end dates differ.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldFailIfOneOfTheMembershipIsNotActive
methods.description: Verifies comparison behavior when one membership is inactive.

methods.name: shouldReturnNegativeValueIfTheMembershipIsNotVoidedAndTheOtherIsAndTheyAreBothEnded
methods.description: Tests comparison when one membership is voided and the other is not, both ended.

methods.name: shouldReturnPositiveValueIfTheMembershipIsVoidedAndTheOtherIsNotAndTheyAreBothEnded
methods.description: Tests comparison when one membership is voided and the other is not, both ended.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldSort
methods.description: Verifies overall sorting order of varied cohort memberships.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueIfObjectReferenceAreTheSame
methods.description: Tests that an object equals itself.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfObjectIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that null is not equal to a CohortMembership instance.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueIfStartDateEndDatePatientIdAreSameInBothObjects
methods.description: Tests equality when start date, end date, and patient ID are identical.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfEndDateAndPatientIdAreNotSameInBothObjects
methods.description: Verifies inequality when end date or patient ID differ.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyStartDateOfOneObjectIsNull
methods.description: Checks inequality if only one start date is null.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyEndDateOfOneObjectIsNull
methods.description: Checks inequality if only one end date is null.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueIfPatientIdIsEqualAndStarDateAndEndDateAreBothNull
methods.description: Tests equality when patient ID and both dates are null.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueWhenBothPatientIdsAreNullAndEndDateAndStartDateAreEqual
methods.description: Tests equality for two objects with null patient ID and matching dates.

methods.name: euqal_shouldPreventAddingTwoEqualObjectsToACollection
methods.description: Confirms that duplicate objects are prevented in a collection due to proper equals/hashCode implementation.
